svg.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Financial Intelligence Engine (FIE) — Question to Answer
How a loaded workbook and a natural-language question become a cited, confidence-rated answer
workbook loads once (Layer 1); each question runs Layers 2–8
Parse the uploaded workbook once into a queryable fact store.
Excel → long-format facts (statement, year, value, cell)
Classify each sheet (statement / detail / ledger / insights)
Read source & validation ledgers → per-fact provenance
Turn the natural-language question into a structured intent.
Rules extract intent, metric(s), year, formula, company
Ontology maps query terms → canonical metrics (aliases)
LLM resolves follow-ups ("and 2024?") from chat history
Decide which sources to consult for this intent.
Route to workbook (internal) and/or external APIs
Pick sources by intent (news, PSX, dividends, forecasts…)
Shortlist relevant APIs from the registry; budget-capped
Gather cited evidence from the workbook and the web.
Workbook lookup → facts with citations (cell / page)
External APIs: news, PSX prices, dividends, forecasts
Resilient HTTP: retry · circuit-breaker · cache · SSRF guard
Compute ratios and run the intent-specific handler.
Formula engine: ratios, margins, growth, EBITDA, FCF…
13 intent handlers (lookup, ratio, trend, overview, risk…)
LLM agent tool-composer when intent unknown / no facts
Rank, role-tag, and reconcile the evidence.
News: chunk → embed (BGE) → rank vs query → dedup
Admission: tag each item baseline / supporting / forecast…
Score the answer, then render it with citations.
Confidence: weakest-link score → High / Medium / Low
7-section answer; every finding must carry a citation [Cn]
LLM narration over the reasoning graph (numeric-guarded)
Persist the reasoning trail and return the answer.
Return: direct answer · findings · analysis · confidence
Echo the frame so the next follow-up has context
direct answer · key findings [with citations] · supporting analysis · calculations
confidence band (High / Med / Low) · exposed conflicts · coverage
sidecar trace.json: full reasoning trail (frame · plan · evidence · response)
Cross-cutting · conversation memory (follow-ups) · citation enforcement · contract checks (bootcheck) · degradation handling · reasoning trace
